---
name: Docs friction
about: Something in the README, guides, or reference docs confused you, was missing, or was wrong
title: ""
labels: documentation
assignees: ""
---

**Which doc**
Link (or path) to the file, and the section/heading if it's a long one.

**What you were trying to do**
The task you came to the doc for.

**Where it broke down**
- [ ] The doc said something that turned out to be false (state what
      you actually observed instead)
- [ ] A command in the doc didn't work as written
- [ ] The doc assumed knowledge it didn't provide or link to
- [ ] The doc just doesn't cover this case
- [ ] Other (describe)

**What would have unblocked you**
Even a rough guess is useful — the exact wording isn't the point, the
gap is.

**Found during a dogfooding session?**
If this came out of a [`DOGFOODING.md`](../../DOGFOODING.md) session,
add the `dogfooding` label and note which phase (cold start / guided
build / the hook) it happened in.
